Label: Author in SemOpenAlex
Problem: Naming is ambiguous - unclear whether this represents an entity or an external link node; name overlaps with SemOpenAlex but is not SemOpenAlex's own class
Proposed action: Remove and model instead as sr:ExternalLink (target: SemOpenAlex Author IRI)

Label: Forked Repository
Problem: Fork status is modeled as a permanent class, but fork status should be a property (boolean) of Repository, not a separate class
Proposed action: Convert to sr:isFork (xsd:boolean) datatype property on sr:Repository

Label: GitHub Bot
Problem: Sits independently from the Person hierarchy - but a bot is also a type of GitHub account, inconsistently placed
Proposed action: Move under new sr:GitHubAccount hierarchy as sr:GitHubBot

Label: GitHub Contributor Reference
Problem: Duplicate naming with contributorReference (lowercase); n-ary relation node but lacks SHACL constraints, commit count is not tied to a snapshot
Proposed action: Rename to sr:Contribution, attach to sr:RepositorySnapshot

Label: GitHub Issue Label Reference
Problem: Duplicate naming with IssueLabelReference (no 'GitHub' prefix); n-ary node for issue labels but no clear link to a specific issue snapshot in time
Proposed action: Rename to sr:IssueLabel, ensure single canonical name, no duplicate class

Label: GitHub organisation
Problem: Duplicate naming with 'organization' (US spelling, different casing); unclear whether Organisation is a GitHub account type or a separate concept
Proposed action: Merge duplicates into single sr:GitHubOrganisation class under new sr:GitHubAccount hierarchy

Label: GitHub Repository Issues
Domain: Domain of: hasIssueAuthor, hasIssueLabelReference (Reference object for Issue Labels), dcterms:created, dcterms:title, fabio:hasURL
Problem: Duplicate naming with lowercase 'issue' class; CRITICALLY shares rdfs:domain with GitHubBot/ForkedRepository/organization/Package/Person/Repository via fabio:hasURL, dcterms:created and dcterms:title - under OWL semantics this creates unintended class-intersection inferences, reproducing exactly the reasoner bug flagged by Reviewer 1
Proposed action: Rename to sr:Issue; remove fabio:hasURL entirely per plan point 13; replace shared rdfs:domain declarations with SHACL sh:or

Label: GitHub Repository Language Reference
Problem: Duplicate naming with 'languageReference'; language usage values (bytes/percentage) are time-dependent but attached directly without snapshot linkage
Proposed action: Rename to sr:LanguageUsage, attach to sr:RepositorySnapshot instead of sr:Repository directly

Label: Package utilised in a Code base.
Problem: Verbose/non-standard label (contains a full sentence with trailing period instead of a concise class name); per Michael's plan point 1, Package should not be included in core model unless explicitly required by a competency question in WP2
Proposed action: Exclude from core ontology pending WP2 decision; document exclusion rationale

Label: Person
Domain: Domain of: dcterms:created, fabio:hasURL, foaf:accountName, foaf:description, foaf:mbox, foaf:name, hasBlog, hasFollowers, hasLocation, hasPublicRepos, hasTwitterAccount (all shared with unrelated classes via OR, causing OWL intersection); also domain of separate 'Person's type' property
Range: Range of: hasContributor, hasStargazer, hasWatcher, hasIssueAuthor, creatorOfAResource, repositoryForkedBy
Problem: Single class models every GitHub account type (humans, bots, orgs); role expressed TWICE via contradictory mechanisms - both permanent rdf:type subclasses (Author/Contributor/etc.) AND a separate 'hasPersonType' property; massive domain pollution shared with 6+ unrelated classes causing reasoner intersection bug identical to Reviewer 1's finding
Proposed action: Split into sr:GitHubAccount hierarchy; remove duplicate role-typing property; remove fabio:hasURL; replace shared rdfs:domain with SHACL sh:or

Label: Author
Domain: SubClassOf: Person only - no independent property domain/range usage found
Problem: Orphan subclass - no property in the schema references Author/Contributor/Forker/IssueAuthor/Stargazer/Watcher directly as domain or range; all relevant properties (hasContributor, hasStargazer, etc.) point to generic Person instead, meaning role subclasses are likely only assigned via manual rdf:type on individuals and duplicate the separate 'Person's type' property
Proposed action: Replace fixed role subclasses entirely with either (a) the qualified sr:ExternalLink/role-association pattern, or (b) a single controlled-vocabulary property (e.g. sr:hasPersonType with SKOS concepts) - not both; apply same decision to Contributor, Forker, IssueAuthor, Stargazer, Watcher

Label: Contributor
Problem: Same orphan-subclass pattern as sr:Author
Proposed action: See sr:Author - single consistent decision to apply to all 6 role subclasses

Label: Forker
Problem: Same orphan-subclass pattern as sr:Author
Proposed action: See sr:Author

Label: Issue Author
Problem: Same orphan-subclass pattern as sr:Author
Proposed action: See sr:Author

Label: Stargazer
Problem: Same orphan-subclass pattern as sr:Author
Proposed action: See sr:Author

Label: Watcher
Problem: Same orphan-subclass pattern as sr:Author
Proposed action: See sr:Author

Label: repository
Problem: Lowercase duplicate of sr:Repository - likely an accidental leftover from early ontology drafts or inconsistent naming convention across contributors
Proposed action: Delete entirely; consolidate all usage into single sr:Repository class

Label: organization
Problem: Duplicate of GitHub organisation (US vs UK spelling, different casing) - same concept modeled twice under two names
Proposed action: Delete; consolidate into single sr:GitHubOrganisation class

Label: IssueLabelReference
Problem: Duplicate of GitHubIssueLabelReference (missing 'GitHub' prefix) - same naming inconsistency pattern seen elsewhere
Proposed action: Delete; consolidate into single sr:IssueLabel class per earlier decision

Label: contributorReference
Problem: Duplicate of GitHubContributorReference (lowercase, no prefix) - same naming inconsistency pattern
Proposed action: Delete; consolidate into single sr:Contribution class per earlier decision

Label: languageReference
Problem: Duplicate of GitHubRepositoryLanguageReference (lowercase, no prefix) - same naming inconsistency pattern
Proposed action: Delete; consolidate into single sr:LanguageUsage class per earlier decision

Label: Repository Topic
Problem: Topic as a class rather than a controlled vocabulary/string value; unclear whether topics are free-text GitHub tags or a curated taxonomy
Proposed action: Clarify via WP2 competency questions whether Topic needs to be a first-class entity (e.g. for topic-based querying) or can be a simple xsd:string property on RepositorySnapshot

Label: Repository
Domain: Domain of: creatorOfAResource, hasIssue, hasLpwcRepositoryUrl, hasMlseaSoftwareEntityUrl, hasSoaAuthorUrl, hasStargazer, hasWatcher, referenceObjectForContributor, repositoryForkedAs, utilisedPackage, dcterms:abstract, dcterms:title (shared), fabio:hasURL (shared with 6 others), hasTotalForks/hasTotalOpenIssues/hasTotalStargazers/hasTotalWatchers (shared with ForkedRepository)
Problem: CONFIRMS plan point 4: mutable counts (stars/forks/watchers/open issues) attached directly to Repository instead of a Snapshot; also confirms plan point 6: hasLpwcUrl/hasMlseaUrl/hasSoaUrl are direct properties instead of qualified ExternalLink nodes; participates in the fabio:hasURL intersection bug as the 7th affected class; hasTotalForks oddly duplicated between Repository and ForkedRepository suggesting two conflicting count sources
Proposed action: Split into sr:Repository (stable identity only: githubRepositoryId, canonicalUrl, createdAt) + sr:RepositorySnapshot (all counts, dates, description); replace hasLpwcUrl/hasMlseaUrl/hasSoaUrl with sr:ExternalLink; remove fabio:hasURL

Label: Repository in LinkedPapersWithCode
Problem: Architecturally incorrect: SemRepo defines its own local proxy class to represent an external LPWC entity instead of simply linking to LPWC's own IRI; blurs ontology boundary between SemRepo's domain and external KGs
Proposed action: Remove class entirely; sr:ExternalLink's linkTarget should point directly to the external LPWC IRI without asserting a local rdf:type

Label: Software entities
Problem: Same architectural flaw as Repository in LinkedPapersWithCode, but for MLSea-KG; also has a typo in its own rdfs:comment ('entitiy')
Proposed action: Remove class entirely; use sr:ExternalLink targeting MLSea-KG IRI directly

Label: hasContributorReference
Range: Range of: 'Reference object for Contributor' property
Problem: Misleadingly named as if it were a property (has... prefix) but is actually declared as a Class, used as Range of a separate property called 'Reference object for Contributor'; duplicates/conflicts with already-catalogued GitHubContributorReference and contributorReference classes - THREE different class names for what should be one sr:Contribution concept
Proposed action: Delete; consolidate all three (hasContributorReference, GitHubContributorReference, contributorReference) into single sr:Contribution class

Label: hasIssueLabelReference
Range: Range of: 'Reference object for Issue Labels' property
Problem: Same misleading-name-as-class pattern as hasContributorReference; a THIRD duplicate alongside GitHubIssueLabelReference and IssueLabelReference for the same concept
Proposed action: Delete; consolidate all three into single sr:IssueLabel class

Label: Inconsistent class typing (rdf:Class vs owl:Class)
Problem: 9 classes (Author, Contributor, Forker, GitHub Bot, GitHub organisation, Issue Author, Person, Stargazer, Watcher) are typed as rdf:Class instead of owl:Class; non-standard for an OWL ontology and may prevent reasoners from treating them as full OWL classes
Proposed action: When rebuilding in semrepo-v2.ttl, declare every class consistently as owl:Class; add a test/SHACL check that verifies no class uses rdf:Class as its type
